(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (border-cells obj)
      (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                              (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
              (positions-in-rect (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 1)
                                     (equal? (sort (obj-cells o) cell<?) (sort (border-cells o) cell<?))))
                    (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b) (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (define idx (- (length (find-color g 2)) 1))
    (define selected (list-ref frames idx))
    (define inner (and (< (+ idx 1) (length frames)) (list-ref frames (+ idx 1))))
    (for*/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (+ (obj-r1 selected) 1) (obj-r2 selected))]
                          [c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 selected) 1) (obj-c2 selected))])
      (if (and (= (at out r c) 0)
               (or (not inner)
                   (not (and (>= r (obj-r1 inner)) (<= r (obj-r2 inner))
                             (>= c (obj-c1 inner)) (<= c (obj-c2 inner))))))
          (set-cell out r c 8)
          out))))
